# External Interface Notes

## Organizational Directory

User accounts and basic department data are synchronized each night from the
organizational directory. Team membership is then adjusted manually in Case
Ledger.

## Document Archive

Cases marked for long-term retention send attachment copies to a document
archive through a nightly secure file transfer. The acknowledgement file is
checked manually after failures.

## Finance Reference Data

A weekly flat file supplies cost-center values used during case
classification. The responsible finance contact and formal file specification
were not included in the project material.

## Reporting

The weekly reporting pack reads from replicated database tables. Operations
also receives a daily spreadsheet generated by a scheduled job. The
spreadsheet recipient list is embedded in configuration.

## Notifications

The application submits messages through the internal messaging relay. Delivery
status is not returned to Case Ledger.
